visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with bright orange hair and gold fringe earrings addresses the camera in a close-up shot. Her facial expression is lively with wide eyes and a broad smile, showing her teeth. The background is a clean, modern indoor space with soft lighting. (2) She presents a golden-colored box containing two pairs of silicone hip pads, one set black and one set flesh-toned. She touches the soft, squishy material of the pads to demonstrate their texture and flexibility while looking directly at the viewer. (3) The woman holds up a pair of beige, high-waisted control-top underwear designed to hold the pads. She stretches the waistband with both hands, showing the fabric's elasticity and the internal pockets where the silicone inserts are placed. (4) Stepping back into a medium full shot, she reveals her full outfit: a long-sleeved black velvet dress featuring a large, prominent red lobster design on the front. She stands in a brightly lit, minimalist hallway with cream-colored walls. (5) The camera captures her from the side to establish a 'before' look. She places her hand on her hip, highlighting her natural silhouette against the neutral background. The lighting is even, accentuating the velvet texture of her black dress. (6) In a series of close-up shots, her hands are shown carefully inserting the silicone pads into the designated slots of the beige underwear. The movements are precise as she folds and tucks the material to ensure a smooth fit. (7) She displays the completed assembly of the underwear with the pads inserted. The added volume is clearly visible through the beige fabric. She holds the garment up to the camera, rotating it slightly to show the three-dimensional effect. (8) The scene shifts back to the woman wearing the pads under her lobster dress. She turns to the side, showcasing a significantly more pronounced and lifted hip profile. A second woman in a red beret and floral dress appears, touching the pads. (9) The woman uses hand gestures to explain various styling options while small icons of jeans and skirts appear as overlays. She maintains an excited facial expression, occasionally pointing to her hips to emphasize the aesthetic improvement. (10) The two women engage in a brief, humorous interaction, laughing and gesturing towards each other. Finally, the main speaker waves her hand enthusiastically toward the camera in a farewell gesture before the video cuts to a close-up smile.
